- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment spikes) — reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices during strong negative sentiment — adjust downward bias by 5–10% of recent mean.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast decline after 3–5 consecutive days of high values.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >15% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 2–3% per day until convergence.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment turns negative after 3–5 days, reduce forecast by 1–2% per day until sentiment stabilizes.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate early in negative sentiment cycles — apply 3–5% downward correction for first 7–10 days.
